# PolyYard layered artwork

Created with the built-in image-generation tool. The original `yard-diorama.png` is retained unchanged. `yard-empty.png` is the edited facility plate; `yard-sprites.png` contains transparent truck, forklift and loaded-pallet cutouts. The renderer draws sprite regions without modifying these source images.

## Facility edit prompt

Precise object removal edit. Preserve this exact warehouse diorama, same framing, camera, building, three doors, colors, trees, base, pavement, lighting and all detail. Remove BOTH white trucks (one on middle dock, one on front road) and the small yellow forklift at right. Restore clean pavement and road paint underneath. Middle dock should be a dark empty open doorway. Remove the cargo/pallet stacks at the right of the building only, leaving that staging area empty for animated inventory. Keep left-side stacks as static facility props. Do not redesign or change anything else. Same landscape aspect ratio. No new objects or text.

## Sprite prompt

Create a transparent sprite sheet with THREE separate isolated objects in a single horizontal row, generous gaps, no overlaps. Reference is for EXACT miniature voxel materials, white trucks, isometric camera elevation and daylight. Left third: a single white refrigerated box truck with attached cab, rear upper-right and cab lower-left, long axis slopes from upper-right to lower-left (it will back into the middle dock in reference). Center third: a small yellow forklift, forks pointing lower-left. Right third: one wooden pallet loaded with gray-white cartons. Each object fully visible, same isometric camera as reference, consistent light from upper left. TRULY TRANSPARENT background alpha, no pavement, no scenery, no labels or text, no checkerboard. Truck should occupy most of left third; forklift smaller in center; pallet small in right third. Detailed photoreal voxel miniature style, not flat illustration.
